_comment: Custom presets to drop from a release's generated fixture because their parent system preset was removed from OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer main. Add an entry whenever you delete a shipping preset that older releases had. 'versions' pins the prune to the releases where the preset is known-invalid, so a future release that re-introduces a valid preset with the same name is left untouched. Applied by generate_profile_fixtures.yml before packaging. See OrcaSlicer PR #14595.
